summaries.summary: This slide presents BASF Group's H1 2011 financial results compared to H1 2010, highlighting key performance metrics including sales, EBITDA, and net income. It notes significant growth in sales and earnings, particularly in the chemicals business and acquired Cognis business, with net income rising by 75%.
key_facts: BASF Group H1 2011 net income: €3.9 billion
visible_text: Significant sales and earnings growth in the chemicals business
Excellent performance of the acquired former Cognis business
Earnings in Agricultural Solutions increased despite adverse weather conditions
Sales growth in Oil & Gas was price driven. Net income rose by 34%
